name: ADO work item comment
description: Adds or updates one comment on an Azure DevOps work item, keyed by a marker. The same key always lands on the same comment; a new key adds a new one. No AI involved.

args.name: key
args.label: Comment key
args.description: Marker deciding add vs update. The same key updates its own comment on every run; a new key adds one.

args.name: body
args.label: Comment
args.description: The comment text. The key rides along as a short [eesha:...] line at the end.

args.name: auth
args.label: Auth
args.description: az uses a short-lived token from the CLI's own login - no PAT anywhere. pat is for a machine that cannot have az.

args.name: patEnv
args.label: PAT env var
args.description: Env var holding the personal access token. Read only when auth is pat.
